semiconductor_relevance: Medium — GEMÜ specializes in valves and control systems that are essential for process equipment in semiconductor manufacturing, particularly in sterile applications.
summary: GEMÜ Valves (China) Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer of valves and measurement systems that support the control of liquids, vapors, and gases in semiconductor processes. Their expertise in sterile applications makes them a key player in ensuring clean and controlled environments necessary for semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities: Flow control components including valves and regulators
Measurement and control systems for liquids and gases
Cleaning and washing equipment for assembly and packaging

regional_presence.China: GEMÜ operates in China, providing localized support and manufacturing capabilities for the semiconductor industry.
